import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int maxN = 100000;
    static int[] fact = new int[maxN + 1];
    static int[] inv_fact = new int[maxN + 1];
    static int[] inv_num = new int[maxN + 1];

    static class Data {
        int f, g;
        Data(int f, int g) {
            this.f = f;
            this.g = g;
        }
        Data() {
            this(0, 0);
        }
        Data add(Data other) {
            return new Data(add_mod(this.f + other.f), add_mod(this.g + other.g));
        }
        Data multiply(Data other) {
            long newF = ((long)this.f * other.f) % mod;
            long newG = (add_mod((long)this.f * other.g % mod + (long)this.g * other.f % mod));
            return new Data((int)newF, (int)newG);
        }
    }

    static int add_mod(int x) {
        return x >= mod ? x - mod : x;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int x) {
        return x < 0 ? x + mod : x;
    }

    static int bin_pow(int base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int)res;
    }

    static int sum_series(int x) {
        long val = (long) x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod;
        return (int)val;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        fact[0] = 1;
        inv_fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxN; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int)(((long)i * fact[i - 1]) % mod);
            inv_fact[i] = bin_pow(fact[i], mod - 2);
            inv_num[i] = bin_pow(i, mod - 2);
        }

        Data[] dp = new Data[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new Data();
        }
        dp[0] = new Data(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new Data();
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Data temp = dp[j - 1].multiply(dp[i - j]);
                long tempG = temp.g;
                tempG = (tempG * (i + 1)) % mod;
                long sumVal = sum_series(j - 1) + sum_series(i - j);
                tempG = (tempG + (temp.f * add_mod((int)sumVal)) % mod) % mod;
                temp.g = (int)((tempG * inv_num[i]) % mod);
                long tempF = ((long)temp.f * (i + 1)) % mod;
                tempF = (tempF * inv_num[i]) % mod;
                temp.f = (int)tempF;
                dp[i] = dp[i].add(temp);
            }
        }

        Data[][] table = new Data[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                table[i][j] = new Data();
            }
        }
        table[0][0] = new Data(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int limit = Math.min(i, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    table[i][j] = dp[i];
                } else {
                    for (int k = 0; k < j && k < i; k++) {
                        Data product = dp[k].multiply(table[i - k - 1][j - k]);
                        table[i][j] = table[i][j].add(product);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = ((long) table[n][m].g * fact[m]) % mod;
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
